verdict.rationale: Synctera documents watchlist checks within its KYC/KYB verification, an implied case system with employee case notifications, enhanced due diligence submissions supporting AML review and Customer Risk Rating, and a centralized ops platform shared with the bank partner. Together these cover sanctions screening and parts of alert case handling. missing for 10: documented transaction monitoring, SAR-filing support, an explicit split of compliance duties between fintech, platform and bank, depth on case-management workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
